title: Telomere Maintenance and Gene Amplification in Saccharomyces Genome Database
summary: This cluster revolves around the maintenance of telomeres and gene amplification in the Saccharomyces Genome Database (SGD). Telomere, a method or tool, is involved in mmBIR and has sequence homology with chr II. SUL1, a gene or protein, is amplified by Rad52, pol32, and yku70, and has phenotypic characteristics in SGD. The SUL1 locus, a gene or protein, is mapped to CEN2. Gene amplification, a process or phenotype, is involved in SUL1. chr II, a gene or protein, contains the URA3 gene and is a probe for CEN2. yku70, a gene or protein, is amplified by chr II-R and requires mmBIR. Telomerase, a gene or protein, is involved in the replication of ITS. Oxford Nanopore, a method or tool, has a population sample of yku70Δ-A.
